idleEvidence.method: Counts actual GET tRPC request procedures after 15-second startup settling. Tracks /events and /api/live request starts, completion/failure, active and overlapping requests. startsAfterPriorClose is an observed repeat connection, not proof of why it reconnected; an open request does not establish healthy SSE message delivery.
idleEvidence.limitations: One isolated seeded jobs screen, Clerk stub; not every screen. Connection liveness is HTTP request lifetime, not server heartbeat receipt. Earlier archived 65-second observations retain their original narrower definition.
